text: S610 shows the five Polo CUT failures are repeatable across two CLO exchange trials: S536 R2000 LWPOLYLINE/AAMA and S609 original R12 POLYLINE/ASTM. Both lose one outline vertex on the same five piece roles. Since encoding and export mode changed together, neither factor's independent effect is established. S609 optimization/removal options were off; official CLO help documents options but no vertex-loss fix. The processing stage remains unknown. No V03 gate clears. Next research a distinct rights-compatible free/local apparel CAD receiver/profile and concrete test path; don't spend another trial toggling settings without a source-backed prediction. See E-G04-S610-EXIT.
